root_cause.text: The `ext4_mb_release()` function in the ext4 subsystem incorrectly skipped draining the pending `s_discard_work` queue when the `EXT4_MOUNT_DISCARD` flag was not set, allowing orphaned discard work to persist if the filesystem was remounted without the discard option.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the `if (test_opt(sb, DISCARD))` condition surrounding `flush_work(&sbi->s_discard_work)` in `fs/ext4/mballoc.c`, and the CVE description confirms that remounting with `nodiscard` clears the flag but leaves pending `s_discard_work` neither cancelled nor flushed.
